bad.title: Limited Independent Verification of AI Outputs
bad.description: You tend to rely on AI to check its own work rather than independently cross-referencing AI-generated content against source materials. This creates circular verification loops where errors can persist undetected, undermining the reliability of your collaborative outputs and limiting your ability to build trust-based working relationships with AI systems.

bad.title: Conversational Rather Than Systematic Approach
bad.description: While you effectively correct individual outputs through dialogue, you often address problems case-by-case rather than systematically refining your underlying prompts and processes. This means insights gained from testing don't consistently translate into structural improvements that enhance future consistency and enable AI to work more independently.

bad.title: Preference for Delegation Over Collaborative Exploration
bad.description: When faced with complex analytical tasks, you tend to present all information at once and request complete solutions rather than progressively uncovering patterns through iterative hypothesis-testing. This approach, while efficient for reaching answers, limits opportunities to surface unexpected insights, identify subtle issues, or develop deeper understanding through collaborative discovery.

good.title: Strong Conceptual Learning Through Active Engagement
good.description: You demonstrate genuine intellectual curiosity and persistence when working through complex concepts, engaging in iterative questioning rather than accepting surface-level answers. Your ability to recognize distinctions, identify classification errors, and build sophisticated understanding through practical interaction shows a valuable learning orientation that supports effective AI collaboration.

good.title: Effective Translation of Structural Requirements
good.description: You excel at communicating formatting and procedural expectations to AI systems, clearly specifying evidence requirements like timestamp citations and output structures. This skill in bridging the communication gap for task specifications ensures that AI understands exactly what format and supporting documentation you need.

good.title: Sound Judgment in Identifying Substantive Issues
good.description: You consistently focus on meaningful problems rather than getting distracted by trivial details, demonstrating practical discernment in distinguishing important misalignments from minor stylistic concerns. This foundational judgment helps direct attention toward issues that genuinely matter.

overall.overview: Throughout this assessment, you demonstrated **practical problem-solving skills and solid conceptual learning ability**, consistently engaging with complex tasks and showing genuine persistence in working toward solutions. Your strengths lie in **identifying issues when presented with concrete examples** and maintaining conversational, iterative dialogue with AI to achieve functional outcomes. To reach the next level of AI collaboration capability, focus on developing more **systematic approaches to verification, task decomposition, and translating your intuitive understanding into explicit frameworks** that enable AI to work more independently and reliably from the outset.

improvements.title: Develop Independent Cross-Verification Habits
improvements.description: Build the practice of actively checking AI-provided evidence against original source materials yourself rather than asking the AI to verify its work. When AI provides timestamps, quotes, or citations, take the time to locate and compare them directly with the source—this critical habit will dramatically strengthen the reliability of your collaborative outputs and your ability to catch errors before they compound.

improvements.title: Transform Insights Into Systematic Prompt Improvements
improvements.description: When you discover what works and what doesn't through testing, translate those learnings into explicit structural changes to your prompts rather than just correcting individual outputs. Build prompts with clear definitions, step-by-step reasoning processes, and specific criteria that enable AI to apply consistent logic independently—treat prompt development as an iterative design process with multiple deliberate refinement cycles.

improvements.title: Break Complex Tasks Into Sequential Verification Passes
improvements.description: Rather than requesting comprehensive analysis in a single sweep, decompose challenging tasks into distinct phases with specific verification objectives for each. For example, first extract key information, then analyze it against criteria, then check for consistency—this structured approach makes it easier to identify exactly where problems occur and creates natural verification points that improve overall accuracy.
